name: Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd. engages in the pharmaceutical industry in China. The company develops Chidamide, a subtype-selective histone deacetylase inhibitor for peripheral T-cell lymphoma, breast cancer, and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma indications; Chiglitazar, a PPAR full agonist for diabetes treatment; Siglitazone for metabolism treatment area; and Cioronib, a novel molecular, which selectively inhibits tumor-related protein kinase targets. It is also involved in the development of CS23546, a small molecule PD-L1 inhibitor, which relieves the immunosuppressive activity mediated by the PD-1/PD-L1 signaling pathway; CS231295, a brain-penetrating selective Aurora B inhibitor…
